objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Describe how Enlightenment thinkers believed people could use reason to improve society and government.

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Sequence major milestones of the Enlightenment, from the publication of key works to the spread of ideas through salons and the Encyclopedie.

standards: C3 D2.His.1.K-2 — Create a chronological sequence of multiple events (history, grades K-2)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Generate possible reasons why Enlightenment ideas about liberty and natural rights spread rapidly across Europe and the American colonies.

standards: C3 D2.His.14.K-2 — Generate possible reasons for an event or development in the past (history, grades K-2)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Explain the central ideas of Enlightenment thinkers such as John Locke, Montesquieu, Voltaire, and Rousseau.

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Analyze how Enlightenment ideas of natural rights, separation of powers, and popular sovereignty influenced the American and French Revolutions.

standards: C3 D2.His.14.9-12 — Analyze multiple and complex causes and effects of events in the past (history, grades 9-12)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Assess how the significance of thinkers like Locke and Rousseau changed over time as their ideas were applied in new political contexts.

standards: C3 D2.His.3.9-12 — Use questions generated about individuals and groups to assess how the significance of their actions (history, grades 9-12)

objectives.topic_name: Enlightenment & Constitutional Conflict (The Road to American Founding)
objectives.objective_text: Evaluate how the Enlightenment emerged from the unique intellectual circumstances of the Scientific Revolution and the broader context of early modern Europe.
